question: What percentage of developers who have tried AI coding tools use them every day?
expected_behavior: Answers 72% and cites the developer survey, page 5.
rationale: Baseline: a single fact stated plainly in one place.
evidence: 72% of developers who have tried AI use it every day

question: In the METR study, how did allowing AI tools affect how long experienced open-source developers took to complete tasks?
expected_behavior: States that completion time increased by 19% (AI slowed developers down), citing METR page 1.
rationale: Counter-intuitive finding: a model leaning on prior beliefs may invert it.
evidence: allowing AI actually increases completion time by 19%
notes: Verified against the abstract on p.1.
